snippet.title: Letter Trek - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Join your friends on a playful roadtrip with word games at each stop! Letter Trek is fun for all ages. Build an epic crossword tower in Sandy Stacks. Race to spell the most words in Lightning Letters. And watch out for Sassy, the radical sasquatch! 

Letter Trek is coming soon to Amazon Luna's GameNight. Luna is a gaming service that lets you play games from the cloud using devices you already own. GameNight is a collection of Luna party games that you can play locally with friends and family. It's all included with an Amazon Prime subscription. Use your TV and phone to play!

🕹️PLAY NOW: https://luna.amazon.com/game/letter-trek/B0GTRYV4BD
